name: Clinaza
description: Clinaza, operated by Mellowprints, provides clinic tools and is onboarding clinics for digital financing desk activation. Patient financing is not live yet.

clinic_pricing.description: ₹999 one-time digital financing desk activation and merchant underwriting, including clinic verification, doctor KYC underwriting, and Pine Labs lending gateway integration. Free clinic CRM is separate. Applicable transaction charges and patient lender terms are separate.

capabilities.name: Patient Point-of-Care EMI Financing
capabilities.description: Planned point-of-care patient payment options after clinic activation, using Plural by Pine Labs gateway rails. Relevant lenders decide credit eligibility, sanctioned amounts, rates, fees and repayment. Net clinic settlement is invoice less applicable MDR and agreed charges on the T+1 schedule after successful processing.
treatments_supported: Cosmetic Smile Makeovers & Full Mouth Rehabilitation
IVF & Fertility Treatments (ICSI, Donor Cycles, IUI, Cryopreservation)

capabilities.name: Practice Management Software
capabilities.description: Free digital prescription generator, FDI tooth charting, automated WhatsApp patient recalls, and clinic management system for doctors in India.

availability.description: Patient checkout requires clinic verification, partner underwriting and payment activation.
